title: HELIX Terminology: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) Status
description: Federal financial aid eligibility status based on academic performance and pace of completion.

codes.definition: Student meets all SAP requirements (GPA, pace, maximum timeframe)
Student failed to meet SAP at the end of a payment period. Eligible for aid for one more period without appeal.
Student failed SAP, appealed successfully, and is on a monitored academic plan. Eligible for aid while on plan.
Student is ineligible for federal financial aid due to failure to meet SAP requirements
SAP appeal approved. Student placed on probation with an academic plan.
SAP has not been evaluated for this period (e.g., first term)

notes: SAP is a federal (Title IV) requirement in the US. Institutions must evaluate SAP at least once per academic year. Three components: qualitative (GPA), quantitative (pace/completion rate), and maximum timeframe.
